run_vl_model_inference: run offline inference on a vision language model like LLaVA or Qwen2-VL with image or video input
run_llava_inference: run offline inference on LLaVA 1.5 or LLaVA-NeXT models with image questions using vLLM
run_qwen_vl_inference: run offline inference on Qwen-VL, Qwen2-VL, or Qwen2.5-VL models with image or video input
run_phi_vision_inference: run offline inference on Phi-3.5-vision or Phi-4-multimodal-instruct models with image input and optional LoRA
run_ocr_model_inference: run offline inference on OCR models like DeepSeek-OCR, Dots-OCR, or HunyuanOCR with custom logits processors
